correctness.rationale: A new point of the homogeneous K₄-free graph is determined over the named set by a neighborhood containing no triangle. With two forbidden triangles the only overlap term is zᵈ(1+z)ⁿ⁻ᵈ for union size d=4,5,6; it increases coefficientwise as d decreases. Forgetting one or both forbidden triangles gives the remaining comparisons. Independently enumerated the seven nonempty Venn-cell occupancies of three marked 3-sets in review-work/triangles.py, rather than enumerating labeled triangle triples. Every ordered support pattern occurs this way. Edge union is an admissibility test: additional triangles in it would also be forced in any realizing graph, and if it has exactly three there can be no K₄. Direct subset counts reproduce the full nine-point table, both seven-point witnesses and their common total 91. For n=5,…,9, the counts are (2,4,7,8,9), with (0,0,2,2,2) unordered incomparable pairs, and no realization below five. Triangle support has size at most nine and outside vertices add a free factor 1+z each. This embeds the nine-point possibilities at all larger orders and is injective on polynomials. Both incomparable differences among the nine profiles have opposite first and last nonzero signs, which survive multiplication by (1+z)ʰ; comparable pairs stay comparable. Thus the census supports the exact all-size conclusion, not just persistence of one pair. Replay: review-work/triangles.txt.
